Well, since it was the end of the final movie, the [[Endor Celebration]] is the Celebration to end all Celebrations - and this card proves it! It can cancel all other Celebrations in progress. Come to the real party baby! It's secondary function is also fantastic. This little extra generation makes it a destiny 5 Used interrupt that you can recycle every one of your turns. Very handy for tracking those big numbers.

Combos: - a handy way to convince your opponent to try another planet. Foil [[Endor Celebration]]: nothing extra, just looks nice and shiny. :)
